description:
List employers in the FormBro LMIA management system.

This tool retrieves a paginated list of employers who have LMIA applications.
Each employer record includes company information, contact details, and business addresses.

Args:
  - limit (number): Maximum results to return, 1-100 (default: 20)
  - offset (number): Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)
  - search (string, optional): Search query to filter by company name, business number, etc.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'markdown')

Returns:
  Paginated list of employers with company information and contact details.

Examples:
  - "List all employers" -> params: {}
  - "Find employer Tech Corp" -> params: { search: "Tech Corp" }
  - "Get employers page 2" -> params: { offset: 20, limit: 20 }

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default: 20)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for machine-readable

search.description: Search query to filter results (searches name, email, etc.)

stream.description: LMIA stream: 'hws' (High-Wage), 'lws' (Low-Wage), 'ee' (Express Entry). Employers are shared across streams.

name: formbro_list_employers
title: List FormBro Employers
